Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
One Fast Cat • AI Assistant
No. Once an order is placed, items on the order cannot be modified, including adding products, removing products, or changing color or quantity.
If the order has not shipped yet, you may be able to request a cancellation and then place a new order with the additional item. Once the order has shipped, it cannot be canceled.
The policy is here: Order Changes & Shipping Address Changes
